// Generated from packages/capability-product-judge/workflows/product_judge/product_judge.workflow-source.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
digraph product_judge {
    label = "product_judge"
    workflow_source = "packages/capability-product-judge/workflows/product_judge/product_judge.workflow-source.mjs"
    typed_action_transport_mode = "enforced"
    build_judge_context [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="judge.build_context_contract" label="Build judge context contract" output_format="json" outputs="judge_context_path,judge_context_sha256,judge_context_valid,judge_context_error,judge_scenario_selection_path,judge_scenario_selection_sha256,judge_scenario_selection_signature_sha256" action_gh_repo="${gh_repo}" action_judge_context_raw="${merge_candidates}" action_judge_evidence_path="${judge_evidence_path}" action_judge_evidence_sha256="${judge_evidence_sha256}" action_judge_kind="issue_execution_post_merge" action_judge_rubric="alignment.default" action_milestone_title="${milestone_title}" action_objective_id="post_merge_alignment" action_scenario_selector="astrochicken" action_subject_id="${milestone_title}" action_worktree_dir="${repo}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    build_judge_context_recovery_packet [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="judge.build_recovery_packet" label="Build judge context recovery packet" output_format="json" outputs="judge_context_recovery_packet_path,judge_context_recovery_packet_id,judge_context_recovery_packet_schema_version,judge_context_recovery_packet_storage_class,judge_context_recovery_packet_type" action_repo="${repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_run_id="${__run_id}" action_pipeline="issue_execution" action_node_id="build_judge_context_recovery_packet" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_error_text="${judge_context_error}" action_gate_code="${judge_context_gate_code}" action_judge_context_path="${judge_context_path}" action_judge_context_scope_identity="issue_execution" action_judge_evidence_path="${judge_evidence_path}" action_judge_kind="issue_execution_post_merge" action_milestone_title="${milestone_title}" action_packet_type="judge_context_contract_recovery" action_route_code="${judge_route_code}" action_target_repo="${gh_repo}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    build_judge_evidence [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="judge.build_evidence_contract" label="Build judge evidence contract" output_format="json" outputs="judge_evidence_path,judge_evidence_sha256,judge_evidence_valid,judge_evidence_error" action_judge_context_raw="${merge_candidates}" action_judge_kind="issue_execution_post_merge" action_require_qa_markers="true" action_subject_id="${milestone_title}" action_worktree_dir="${repo}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    build_judge_evidence_recovery_packet [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="judge.build_recovery_packet" label="Build judge evidence recovery packet" output_format="json" outputs="judge_evidence_recovery_packet_path,judge_evidence_recovery_packet_id,judge_evidence_recovery_packet_schema_version,judge_evidence_recovery_packet_storage_class,judge_evidence_recovery_packet_type" action_repo="${repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_run_id="${__run_id}" action_pipeline="issue_execution" action_node_id="build_judge_evidence_recovery_packet" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_error_text="${judge_evidence_error}" action_gate_code="${judge_evidence_gate_code}" action_judge_context_path="${judge_context_path}" action_judge_context_scope_identity="issue_execution" action_judge_evidence_path="${judge_evidence_path}" action_judge_kind="issue_execution_post_merge" action_milestone_title="${milestone_title}" action_packet_type="judge_evidence_contract_recovery" action_route_code="${judge_route_code}" action_target_repo="${gh_repo}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    close_milestone [type="tool" governance="irreversible" label="Close milestone" output_key="close_milestone_status" prompt="# hatch:no-inline-script-ok\ngh api repos/${gh_repo}/milestones --state open --jq '.[] | select(.title==\"${milestone_title}\") | .number' | xargs -I{} gh api -X PATCH repos/${gh_repo}/milestones/{} -f state=closed >/dev/null" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    decide [shape="diamond" label="Judge pass?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    done [shape="Msquare" recovery_sink_type="terminal"]
    judge [class="post_merge_judge" benchmark_job_id="issue.execute.judge" prompt_version="2026-03-09.r1" role_version="1.0.0" skill_id="issue.execute" label="Post-merge judge" outputs="disposition,confidence,recommended_transition,reason_codes,notes,verdict" prompt="You are the post-merge judge for ${gh_repo}.\n\nSurvey the existing scenario registry and use zero, one, or at most two scenarios only when they materially sharpen judgment for this merged work. Scenarios are optional and sparse; do not force them.\nTreat scenarios as high-value judgment aids, not exhaustive checklists.\nDo NOT reveal or quote any scenario. Provide a redacted verdict envelope.\n\nMerged issues: ${merge_results}\n\nReturn JSON:\n{\n  \"schema\": \"verdict/v1\",\n  \"verdict_kind\": \"post_merge_judge\",\n  \"disposition\": \"approve|reject|defer|escalate\",\n  \"confidence\": \"high|medium|low\",\n  \"recommended_transition\": \"close_milestone|open_followup|request_more_evidence|escalate_contract\",\n  \"observation\": {\n    \"alignment_score\": 0.0,\n    \"constraint_violations\": [],\n    \"missing_evidence\": []\n  },\n  \"recommendation\": {\n    \"action\": \"close_milestone|open_followup|request_more_evidence|escalate_contract\",\n    \"next_steps\": [\"Redacted feedback or confirmation\"]\n  },\n  \"reason_codes\": [\"POST_MERGE_ALIGNED|POST_MERGE_MISALIGNED|POST_MERGE_EVIDENCE_GAP|POST_MERGE_CONTRACT_INVALID\"],\n  \"notes\": \"Concise human-readable rationale\"\n}\n\nRules:\n- If disposition=approve, recommended_transition must be close_milestone.\n- If disposition=reject, recommended_transition must be open_followup.\n- If disposition=defer, recommended_transition must be request_more_evidence.\n- If disposition=escalate, recommended_transition must be escalate_contract.\n- reason_codes must be non-empty.\nReturn JSON only." objective_id="post_merge_alignment" scenarios="astrochicken"]
    judge_context_gate [shape="diamond" label="Judge context complete?"]
    judge_evidence_gate [shape="diamond" label="Judge evidence complete?"]
    open_followup [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="wave.open_judge_followup" label="Open follow-up" output_key="open_followup_status" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_run_id="${__run_id}" action_pipeline="issue_execution" action_judge_notes="${notes}" action_milestone_title="${milestone_title}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    start [shape="Mdiamond"]
    validate_judge_context [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="judge.validate_context_contract" label="Validate judge context contract" output_format="json" outputs="judge_context_gate_pass,judge_context_gate_code,judge_context_error,judge_context_path,judge_context_sha256,judge_scenario_selection_path,judge_scenario_selection_sha256,judge_scenario_selection_signature_sha256,judge_route_code,disposition,confidence,recommended_transition,reason_codes,notes,verdict" action_judge_context_error="${judge_context_error}" action_judge_context_path="${judge_context_path}" action_judge_context_raw="${merge_candidates}" action_judge_context_sha256="${judge_context_sha256}" action_judge_context_valid="${judge_context_valid}" action_judge_evidence_path="${judge_evidence_path}" action_judge_evidence_sha256="${judge_evidence_sha256}" action_judge_kind="issue_execution_post_merge" action_judge_rubric="alignment.default" action_objective_id="post_merge_alignment" action_scenario_selector="astrochicken" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    validate_judge_evidence [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="judge.validate_evidence_contract" label="Validate judge evidence contract" output_format="json" outputs="judge_evidence_gate_pass,judge_evidence_gate_code,judge_evidence_error,judge_route_code,disposition,confidence,recommended_transition,reason_codes,notes,verdict" action_judge_context_raw="${merge_candidates}" action_judge_evidence_error="${judge_evidence_error}" action_judge_evidence_path="${judge_evidence_path}" action_judge_evidence_sha256="${judge_evidence_sha256}" action_judge_evidence_valid="${judge_evidence_valid}" action_judge_kind="issue_execution_post_merge" action_require_qa_markers="true" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    start -> build_judge_evidence
    validate_judge_evidence -> judge_evidence_gate
    build_judge_context_recovery_packet -> decide
    build_judge_context -> validate_judge_context
    build_judge_evidence_recovery_packet -> decide
    build_judge_evidence -> build_judge_context
    build_judge_evidence -> validate_judge_evidence [condition="judge_evidence_valid=__contract_edge__"]
    close_milestone -> done
    decide -> close_milestone [condition="disposition=approve"]
    decide -> open_followup [condition="disposition!=approve"]
    judge_context_gate -> build_judge_context_recovery_packet [condition="judge_context_gate_pass!=true"]
    judge_context_gate -> validate_judge_evidence [condition="judge_context_gate_pass=true"]
    judge_evidence_gate -> build_judge_evidence_recovery_packet [condition="judge_evidence_gate_pass!=true"]
    judge_evidence_gate -> judge [condition="judge_evidence_gate_pass=true"]
    judge -> decide
    open_followup -> done
    validate_judge_context -> judge_context_gate
}
